questions.question: Discuss the development of artistic techniques and tools from the Mesolithic to Neolithic periods.
questions.solution_html:
• • Transition from mobile art to permanent structures like megaliths.
  • • Introduction of polished stone tools for carving and shaping.
  • • Use of pottery and clay modeling for functional and decorative purposes.
  • • Refinement of pigment use for more detailed art.
  • • Creation of engravings, reliefs, and larger murals.
  • • Shift from animal depictions to scenes of agriculture and daily life.
  • • Use of geometric patterns and symbolic motifs.
  • • Development of more complex weaving and textile techniques.
  • • Tools became more specialized, improving artistic precision.
  • • Art began reflecting social organization and rituals.
questions.final_answer: • Art began reflecting social organization and rituals
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) Regular Exam Sem 1, Nov 2024
